description: The Cabinet of Uttar Pradesh has given the green light for a cutting-edge robotics and artificial intelligence park in Greater Noida. This innovative project is projected to create more than 100,000 jobs and infuse ₹2,000 crore into the state's economy each year.
body_lead: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet on Tuesday approved the establishment of a robotics and artificial intelligence (AI) park in Greater Noida spread over 69.52 acres, estimated to generate more than 1 lakh direct and indirect jobs and add ₹2,000 crore annually to the state's economy at full scale.
